name: Orion Telecommunications
summary: ASX-listed telco (Orion Telecommunications Ltd, listed 5 Oct 2004; Hobart/Melbourne fixed/mobile/data); merged into M2 Group via scheme Sep/Oct 2007 (ACN 109 038 520).

events.details: Orion Telecommunications Ltd listed on ASX 5 Oct 2004 (fixed/mobile/data, Hobart/Melbourne, plus Irish/UK arm via NewTel).
Merged into M2 Group via scheme of arrangement (approved Sep 2007, completed Oct 2007; ~28c/share: 0.238 M2 shares + ~8.78c cash).
